fitPreferences: Sleeves should finish cleanly at the wrist
Layering should stay visually light rather than bulky
styleDirection: Muted foundations with one energetic accent
Practical outfits with interesting material or construction
profile.publicNotice: This wardrobe and its presentation photos are intentionally public so an AI stylist can use them.

garments.name: Nycra-R lightweight jacket
garments.colorDescription: Muted brown-grey with a slight olive undertone
garments.silhouette: Regular, lightweight shirt-jacket silhouette with a curved hem
garments.fit: Regular fit; approximately mid-hip on the owner
stylingNotes: Works best as a light outer layer over a T-shirt or thin knit
Avoid relying on it for warmth
The muted tone pairs easily with cream, navy, washed black, and stone

garments.name: Blue, white, and orange sneakers
garments.colorDescription: Deep navy body with pale overlays, white details, and orange accents
garments.silhouette: Chunky, sporty low-top sneaker with a sculpted ridged sole
stylingNotes: Use as the energetic element in an otherwise restrained outfit
The navy connects naturally to dark denim or navy trousers
White or ecru elsewhere in the outfit helps the pale overlays feel intentional

Blue, white, and orange Hermès sneakers worn with light trousers, side detail

garments.name: Distressed black zip high-tops
garments.colorDescription: Washed black and charcoal with a deliberately distressed finish
garments.silhouette: Slim high-top sneaker with a padded ribbed collar, layered lacing, and twin side zips
stylingNotes: Works as a darker, more directional alternative to a plain black sneaker
Pair with washed black denim, charcoal trousers, or muted cargo trousers
Keep the rest of the outfit relatively clean so the zips and distressed texture remain intentional

images.alt: Distressed black high-top sneaker with twin side zips, three-quarter front view
Distressed black high-top sneaker showing its side profile and zips

garments.name: Charcoal brogue hybrid shoes
garments.colorDescription: Very dark charcoal with a subtle grey-green cast, contrast stitching, and burgundy lining
garments.silhouette: Low-profile lace-up combining brogue perforations and paneling with a rugged sneaker-like lug sole
stylingNotes: Useful when an outfit needs more structure than a sneaker but less formality than a dress shoe
Pairs naturally with charcoal, olive, navy, brown, and dark denim
The rugged sole works best with trousers that have enough visual weight rather than very fine tailoring

images.alt: Charcoal grey-green brogue-inspired hybrid shoe viewed from above
Charcoal brogue-inspired hybrid shoe showing paneling and a black lug sole

garments.name: Grey paneled sneakers
garments.colorDescription: Soft mid-grey with darker suede-like overlays, white laces, black heel accents, and an off-white segmented sole
garments.silhouette: Substantial low-top sneaker with layered panels and a deeply segmented sole
stylingNotes: A neutral statement sneaker that works with both light and dark trousers
The off-white sole looks especially coherent with ecru, stone, or light-grey pieces
Use the grey upper to soften all-black outfits without introducing a strong colour accent

images.alt: Pair of grey Hermès low-top sneakers with white laces and segmented soles
Grey Hermès sneaker showing its layered front panels and white lacing

garments.name: Cream and brown paneled sneakers
garments.colorDescription: Cream woven-texture body with warm brown panels, black accents, and a translucent off-white segmented sole
garments.silhouette: Streamlined low-top sneaker with an elongated toe, bold contrast panels, and a chunky segmented sole
stylingNotes: The cream and warm brown palette works naturally with ecru, tan, olive, navy, and washed denim
Treat the black accents as a bridge to darker trousers or outerwear
Best used as the focal point of a relaxed outfit with otherwise simple shapes

Cream and brown Hermès sneaker showing its side paneling and segmented sole

outfits.title: Soft utility, colour pop
outfits.rationale: The quiet brown-grey jacket gives the outfit a calm utility base while the sneakers add controlled colour and visual weight. Keep the pieces between them simple so the two distinctive items do not compete.
missingPieces: Relaxed navy trousers or clean dark denim
